feature.title: Phone and iPad reader: chapter diagrams and the end-of-chapter quiz
feature.problem: The reader shows a chapter's text but drops its diagrams (the 'Your map so far' concept map on every lesson, and Flowmovie movies such as the agent loop) and its 2-3 check questions. Without them a chapter on the phone teaches less than the same chapter on the desktop, and there is no way to check yourself before moving on. Design: the 'End-of-chapter quiz' screen on https://claude.ai/artifact/LUdrDTLccSWPURFiLgHjYS.
nonGoals: Asking the tutor about a wrong answer: Phase 3 adds an 'Ask why' button that opens the tutor sheet.
Drawing or editing diagrams: the reader only plays what the course already has.
Offline diagrams: the Flowmovie player and Mermaid load from the server; Phase 4 caches them.

states.loading: A diagram shows a box of its final height with a quiet 'Loading the movie…' line; the quiz never loads separately (it arrives with the chapter).
states.empty: A chapter with no diagrams and no questions shows neither section; Next chapter follows the text as now.
states.error: A movie that can't load says 'This movie can't play right now' with Try again; a diagram with a syntax slip shows its source text in a code box. A failed answer save says 'Couldn't save your answer' and keeps the choice so a retry is one tap.
states.success: Diagrams play in place. Questions go one at a time: choose, see Right or Not quite with the explanation and the right answer marked, then Next question. After the last: 'You got 2 of 3 right' and a Try again link. Answers already given show as answered when you come back.

components.control: One question at a time with step marks
components.why: the approved design; one question on a phone screen keeps the choices large and the explanation next to them
components.rejected: all questions in one long list (the desktop layout)

components.control: Answer rows as radio buttons (role radio, aria-checked) in a radiogroup
components.why: exactly one choice per question, read correctly by VoiceOver; each row is at least 56 px tall
components.rejected: plain buttons with no selected state

components.control: Diagram rows that open in place (aria-expanded) on phones, open by default from 700 px
components.why: players are heavy and tall; on a phone they load only when asked so scrolling the text stays smooth
components.rejected: a full-screen diagram viewer (one more screen to leave and come back from)

components.control: The vendored Flowmovie player and Mermaid, loaded lazily into a View's DOM node
components.why: react-native-web renders real DOM, so the same players the web app uses run unchanged; nothing loads until a diagram opens
components.rejected: a WebView or iframe (not available on the web, and iframes are slower and harder to size)
